title: The plane that circled Kenge, v2 (mixed media)
voice: Text-led: vo/ empty (ElevenLabs credits at 0). Record 01-09.mp3 from the 'say' lines with voice nJvj5shg2xu1GKGxqfkE and re-render.

lines.say: People in Kenge watched the plane circle their town, again and again.
lines.show: People in Kenge watched the plane circle their town, again and again.

lines.say: On Friday, a plane carrying a military delegation was flying to Congo's capital when a technical fault struck.
lines.show: On Friday, a plane carrying a military delegation was flying to Congo's capital when a technical fault struck.

lines.say: The pilot turned towards Kenge. But Kenge has no landing strip.
lines.show: The pilot turned towards Kenge. But Kenge has no landing strip.

lines.say: Witnesses say it circled several times, then crashed into a residential plot and caught fire.
lines.show: Witnesses say it circled several times, then crashed into a residential plot and caught fire.

lines.say: No one on board survived. The army says fourteen died. Reuters reports thirteen, including a top army general.
lines.show: No one on board survived. The army says 14 died. Reuters reports 13, including a top army general.

bg_spec.by: Maj.-Gen. Efomi Ekenge, Congo's armed forces

lines.say: An official investigation has now begun.
lines.show: An official investigation has now begun.

lines.say: Congo is vast, with few good roads, so small planes connect its cities.
lines.show: Congo is vast, with few good roads, so small planes connect its cities.

events: Kinshasa: plane crashes into a market, about 300 killed
Goma: passenger jet crashes into homes

lines.say: Yet its air-safety record is one of the worst in the world.
lines.show: Yet its air-safety record is one of the worst in the world.
